summary: Current Tripo OpenAPI pricing advertises 300 free API credits (~$3 at 100 credits per $1), with the wording 'in 2 weeks'. The public page does not clarify whether that wording describes delivery timing or credit validity; confirm the allowance and expiry in your API wallet. This supersedes the historical 2,000-credit first-key launch reward. Credits cover supported image and 3D generation tasks. API V2 is no longer maintained from October 1, 2026 and retires November 1, 2026 at 00:00 Beijing Time (UTC+8); follow the published V2-to-V3 migration guide. Uncertainty rechecked 2026-10-14: grant timing, credit validity and a no-card claim flow remain untested in an account. The V2 service cutoff is not the grant's enrollment expiry.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a Tripo API account at https://platform.tripo3d.ai.
Check the API wallet for the advertised 300-credit allowance and its account-specific timing/validity; current public pricing says 'in 2 weeks' without further explanation.
Generate an API key and follow current OpenAPI quickstart and V3 migration documentation. Paid usage uses prepaid credits; a no-card claim flow has not been tested.
